./specs/SPEC-018-agentic-tool-calling.md:249:Note: production Qwen-coding SKUs (e.g. `mlx-community/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct-4bit`, `mlx-community/Qwen3-32B-4bit`) match the Qwen family row via `qwen2.5` or `qwen3` substring. There is no separate "coding-tuned" row in §3.1 — coding-tuned variants advertise as Qwen2.5/Qwen3 derivatives and select the same family; body-grammar disambiguation is performed by the parser per the OR rule above.
./specs/SPEC-018-agentic-tool-calling.md:288:When the buyer-supplied `modelID` substring-matches more than one family row in §3.1, deterministic precedence is declared by table order: the first matching row in §3.1 selects the parser family. At v0.1.3, the two rows have disjoint predicates (`qwen2.5`/`qwen3` for Qwen; `llama-3.3` for Llama) so no `modelID` realistically matches both; the rule is normative for future family additions per §3.7.
./specs/SPEC-018-agentic-tool-calling.md:322:The v0.2 IMPL MUST add golden tests for Qwen3 and Llama-3.3 family rendering. If upstream tokenizer chat templates provide byte-exact tool-call/tool-result rendering for the selected model artifact, the fixture output MUST be byte-exact against that upstream template. Where upstream documentation is not directly byte-stable in this SPEC, the fixture MUST at minimum enforce the normative structure below and record the exact upstream tokenizer-config commit or artifact digest used by the implementation. Implementation references: Qwen3 tokenizer config at `https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-32B/blob/main/tokenizer_config.json`; Llama-3.3 tokenizer config at `https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct/blob/main/tokenizer_config.json`.
./specs/SPEC-018-agentic-tool-calling.md:352:Qwen3 renderer fixture structure:
./specs/SPEC-018-agentic-tool-calling.md:354:- ordinary turns use the Qwen3 chat-template user/assistant turn boundaries from the selected upstream tokenizer config;
./specs/SPEC-018-agentic-tool-calling.md:360:Llama-3.3 renderer fixture structure:
./specs/SPEC-018-agentic-tool-calling.md:362:- ordinary turns use the Llama-3.3 chat-template role/header/end-token boundaries from the selected upstream tokenizer config;
./specs/SPEC-018-agentic-tool-calling.md:363:- the assistant-history call is rendered as a complete Llama-native tool-call block using the family tool-call markup selected by the Llama-3.3 tokenizer config, including the `<|python_tag|>` / `<|eom_id|>` tool-call boundary where that template requires it;
./specs/SPEC-018-agentic-tool-calling.md:492:Tool-call buffered-to-end response synthesis (§4) creates first-header latency on non-streaming requests: headers do not arrive at the gateway until the provider finishes generation and response synthesis. For large coding-class models (Qwen3-Coder-30B-class on M4) first-response latency can exceed 10 seconds, which was the pre-c823a96 gateway `ResponseHeaderTimeout` default.
./specs/SPEC-018-agentic-tool-calling.md:636:AC-18. A non-streaming Qwen3-Coder-class tool-call response completes through any production gateway deployment satisfying the SPEC-002 / SPEC-006 timeout invariants. Marked as **release smoke / manual evidence**: the integration runner `test/integration/tool_calling/openai_tool_call_e2e.py` produces a JSON artifact recording the `OPENAI_BASE_URL`, model SKU, response shape, and completion latency. v0.1 does not pin a specific public deployment URL.
./specs/SPEC-018-agentic-tool-calling.md:658:AC-26. **#1 `role:"tool"` accepted and rendered.** A request containing a valid `role:"tool"` message with string `content` and valid `tool_call_id` is accepted by the provider and rendered into the selected family-native tool-result markup before inference. Empty string content passes. Implementation MUST produce byte-equivalent output to the §3.8 Qwen3 and Llama-3.3 family fixtures where upstream templates are byte-specifiable, or structurally equivalent output with the exact upstream tokenizer-config artifact pinned where the SPEC uses structural fixture requirements. Fail condition: HTTP 400 `unsupported_tool_messages`, dropped `tool_call_id`, rendering that omits the tool result, or non-equivalence to §3.8 fixtures.
./specs/SPEC-018-agentic-tool-calling.md:660:AC-27. **#1 Assistant-history `tool_calls[]` echo accepted and rendered.** A request replaying an earlier assistant message with valid `tool_calls[]` is accepted and rendered into native family tool-call markup so the model sees its prior calls. Implementation MUST produce byte-equivalent output to the §3.8 Qwen3 and Llama-3.3 family fixtures where upstream templates are byte-specifiable, or structurally equivalent output with the exact upstream tokenizer-config artifact pinned where the SPEC uses structural fixture requirements. Fail condition: structured fields are ignored, stripped by `ChatMessage`, rejected solely because they are assistant-history tool calls, or non-equivalence to §3.8 fixtures.

    Bound batched detokenization work at replay boundaries
    
    Constraint: SPEC-038 AC-6c keeps serial tool-turn billing and cache boundaries canonical across duplicate and terminal replays.
    Rejected: Recomputing serial tool stops during finalize | prefix decoding makes long tool argument streams quadratic.
    Confidence: high
    Scope-risk: narrow
    Directive: Keep canonical row stop state scheduler-owned; waiters may replay chunks, not redefine stop boundaries.

+/// Thread-safe runtime-only observer owned by the canonical scheduler row.
+/// Its handler consumes one newly visible token at a time and therefore never
+/// replays a generated prefix. Equality intentionally ignores identity/state
+/// because the observer is not part of request semantics or dedupe identity.
+final class ContinuousBatchCanonicalStopObserver: @unchecked Sendable, Equatable {
+    private let lock = NSLock()
+    private let handler: @Sendable (Int) -> Bool
+    private var observedTokenCount = 0
+    private var stopTokenCountValue: Int?
+
+    init(handler: @escaping @Sendable (Int) -> Bool) {
+        self.handler = handler
+    }
+
+    func observe(_ tokens: [Int]) -> Bool {
+        lock.lock()
+        defer { lock.unlock() }
+        guard stopTokenCountValue == nil else { return false }
+        for token in tokens {
+            observedTokenCount += 1
+            if handler(token) {
+                stopTokenCountValue = observedTokenCount
+                return true
+            }
+        }
+        return false
+    }
+
+    var stopTokenCount: Int? {
+        lock.lock()
+        defer { lock.unlock() }
+        return stopTokenCountValue
+    }
+
+    static func == (
+        lhs: ContinuousBatchCanonicalStopObserver,
+        rhs: ContinuousBatchCanonicalStopObserver
+    ) -> Bool {
+        true
+    }
+}

Author:     Augustas11 <augstar@gmail.com>
AuthorDate: Fri Sep 25 21:41:35 2026 +0800
Commit:     Augustas11 <augstar@gmail.com>
CommitDate: Fri Sep 25 21:41:35 2026 +0800

    Preserve serial completion boundaries across batched replays
    
    Constraint: SPEC-038 v0.2.11 AC-6c requires batched rows to reuse serial finalization semantics.
    Rejected: Per-waiter replay observers | delivery chunking cannot define billing or cache settlement.
    Confidence: high
    Scope-risk: narrow
    Directive: Keep tool-stop billing boundaries derived from canonical row tokens.
    Tested: swift build; focused 210-test gate; revert proofs for finish reason and replay truncation.
    Not-tested: Full Swift suite remains red in this environment (3538 tests, 71 skipped, 198 failures); an observed reconnect timing failure passed in isolation.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

  1116	private func buildStopTokenIds(
  1117	    modelConfiguration: ModelConfiguration,
  1118	    tokenizer: Tokenizer
  1119	) -> Set<Int> {
  1120	    // Build complete EOS token set from all sources.
  1121	    var stopTokenIds = modelConfiguration.eosTokenIds
  1122	    if let tokenizerEOS = tokenizer.eosTokenId {
  1123	        stopTokenIds.insert(tokenizerEOS)
  1124	    }
  1125	    for token in modelConfiguration.extraEOSTokens {

  1128	        }
  1129	    }

  1131	}

  1133	private func runSynchronousGenerationLoop(
  1134	    modelConfiguration: ModelConfiguration,
  1135	    tokenizer: Tokenizer,
  1136	    iterator: TokenIterator,
  1137	    didGenerate: (_ token: Int, _ generatedTokenIds: [Int]) -> GenerateDisposition
  1138	) -> SynchronousGenerationLoopResult {
  1139	    var start = Date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate
  1140	    var promptTime: TimeInterval = 0
  1141	
  1142	    let stopTokenIds = buildStopTokenIds(
  1143	        modelConfiguration: modelConfiguration,
  1144	        tokenizer: tokenizer
  1145	    )
  1146	
  1147	    var generatedTokenIds = [Int]()
  1148	    var iterator = iterator
  1149	    var stopReason: GenerateStopReason?
  1150	
  1151	    while let token = iterator.next() {
  1152	        // Compute the timing for the prompt.
  1153	        if promptTime == 0 {
  1154	            let now = Date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate
  1155	            promptTime = now - start
  1156	            start = now
  1157	        }
  1158	
  1159	        // Check for end-of-sequence tokens.
  1160	        if token == tokenizer.unknownTokenId || stopTokenIds.contains(token) {
  1161	            stopReason = .stop

  1163	        }

  1165	        generatedTokenIds.append(token)

  1177	        } else {
  1178	            stopReason = .cancelled
  1179	        }
  1180	    }

  1182	    let now = Date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate
  1183	    let generateTime = now - start

  1186	    // exits the program right away, those tasks will still be executing and will
  1187	    // hit assertions as the mlx scheduler is torn down. Synchronize with the stream
  1188	    // to make sure it is complete.
  1189	    Stream().synchronize()

  1192	        generatedTokenIds: generatedTokenIds,
  1193	        promptTime: promptTime,
  1194	        generateTime: generateTime,
  1195	        promptPrefillTime: iterator.promptPrefillTime,
  1196	        stopReason: stopReason ?? .cancelled
  1197	    )
  1198	}

  1813	private func generateLoopTask<Handler: TokenLoopHandler>(
  1814	    promptTokenCount: Int,
  1815	    modelConfiguration: ModelConfiguration,
  1816	    tokenizer: Tokenizer,
  1817	    iterator: consuming any TokenIteratorProtocol,
  1818	    wiredMemoryTicket: WiredMemoryTicket? = nil,
  1819	    includeStopToken: Bool = false,
  1820	    handler: consuming Handler
  1821	) -> (AsyncStream<Handler.Output>, Task<Void, Never>) {
  1822	
  1823	    let (stream, continuation) = AsyncStream<Handler.Output>.makeStream()
  1824	
  1825	    let iterator = SendableBox(iterator)
  1826	    let handler = SendableBox(handler)
  1827	
  1828	    // Launch a Task to perform iteration asynchronously.
  1829	    let task = Task {
  1830	        let performIteration = {
  1831	            var iterator = iterator.consume()
  1832	            var handler = handler.consume()
  1833	
  1834	            var start = Date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate
  1835	            var promptTime: TimeInterval = 0
  1836	            var tokenCount = 0
  1837	            var stopReason: GenerateStopReason?
  1838	
  1839	            let stopTokenIds = buildStopTokenIds(
  1840	                modelConfiguration: modelConfiguration,
  1841	                tokenizer: tokenizer
  1842	            )
  1843	
  1844	            tokenLoop: while let token = iterator.next() {
  1845	                // Check for cancellation on every loop iteration.
  1846	                if Task.isCancelled {
  1847	                    stopReason = .cancelled
  1848	                    break
  1849	                }
  1850	
  1851	                if promptTime == 0 {
  1852	                    let now = Date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate
  1853	                    promptTime = now - start
  1854	                    start = now
  1855	                }
  1856	
  1857	                // Check for end-of-sequence tokens
  1858	                if token == tokenizer.unknownTokenId || stopTokenIds.contains(token) {
  1859	                    if includeStopToken {
  1860	                        tokenCount += 1
  1861	                        switch handler.onStopToken(token, emit: continuation.yield) {
  1862	                        case .more:
  1863	                            break
  1864	                        case .stop:
  1865	                            stopReason = .stop
  1866	                            break tokenLoop
  1867	                        case .cancelled:
  1868	                            stopReason = .cancelled
  1869	                            break tokenLoop
  1870	                        }
  1871	                    } else {
  1872	                        iterator.discardGeneratedToken()
  1873	                    }
  1874	                    stopReason = .stop
  1875	                    break
  1876	                }
  1877	
  1878	                tokenCount += 1
  1879	                switch handler.onToken(token, emit: continuation.yield) {
  1880	                case .more:
  1881	                    break
  1882	                case .stop:
  1883	                    stopReason = .stop
  1884	                    break tokenLoop
  1885	                case .cancelled:
  1886	                    stopReason = .cancelled
  1887	                    break tokenLoop
  1888	                }
  1889	            }
  1890	
  1891	            if stopReason == nil {
  1892	                if Task.isCancelled {
  1893	                    stopReason = .cancelled
  1894	                } else if let maxTokens = iterator.maxTokens, iterator.tokenCount >= maxTokens {
  1895	                    stopReason = .length
  1896	                } else {
  1897	                    stopReason = .cancelled
  1898	                }
  1899	            }
  1900	
  1901	            handler.onGenerationEnd(emit: continuation.yield)
  1902	
  1903	            let now = Date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate
  1904	            let generateTime = now - start
  1905	
  1906	            let mtpStats = iterator as? MTPStatsCollecting
  1907	            let info = GenerateCompletionInfo(
  1908	                promptTokenCount: promptTokenCount,
  1909	                generationTokenCount: tokenCount,
  1910	                promptTime: promptTime + iterator.promptPrefillTime,
  1911	                generationTime: generateTime,
  1912	                stopReason: stopReason ?? .cancelled,
  1913	                proposedDraftTokens: mtpStats?.proposedDraftTokens,
  1914	                acceptedDraftTokens: mtpStats?.acceptedDraftTokens,
  1915	                passthroughReason: mtpStats?.passthroughReason,
  1916	                speculativeDecodingTelemetry: iterator.speculativeDecodingTelemetry
  1917	            )
  1918	            _ = continuation.yield(handler.infoEvent(info))
  1919	
  1920	            // Synchronize with the stream to ensure tasks are completed
  1921	            Stream().synchronize()
  1922	
  1923	            // Finalize the stream
  1924	            continuation.finish()
  1925	        }

The dependency source confirms the key risk area: Swift’s tokenizer supports both `ByteLevel` and `ByteFallback` decoders, while the new fast path assumes every native Qwen/Llama tool row is GPT-2 byte-level. I’m validating whether that assumption is exercised by the repository’s existing model-family contracts and completing the prescribed tests before deciding whether it is a material finding.

  3990	        private var heldText = ""
  3991	        private var pendingBytes: [UInt8] = []
  3992	
  3993	        init(tokenPiece: @escaping (Int) -> String?, cleanUpTokenizationSpaces: Bool) {
  3994	            self.tokenPiece = tokenPiece
  3995	            self.cleanUpTokenizationSpaces = cleanUpTokenizationSpaces
  3996	        }
  3997	
  3998	        func append(_ token: Int) -> String {
  3999	            guard let piece = tokenPiece(token) else { return text }
  4000	            if let bytes = Self.byteLevelBytes(piece) {
  4001	                pendingBytes.append(contentsOf: bytes)
  4002	                let incompleteCount = Self.incompleteUTF8SuffixCount(pendingBytes)
  4003	                let stableEnd = pendingBytes.count - incompleteCount
  4004	                if stableEnd > 0 {
  4005	                    heldText += String(decoding: pendingBytes[..<stableEnd], as: UTF8.self)
  4006	                    pendingBytes.removeFirst(stableEnd)
  4007	                }
  4008	            } else {
  4009	                if !pendingBytes.isEmpty {
  4010	                    heldText += String(decoding: pendingBytes, as: UTF8.self)
  4011	                    pendingBytes.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)
  4012	                }
  4013	                heldText += piece
  4014	            }
  4015	
  4016	            // Match NaiveStreamingDetokenizer: an incomplete/invalid UTF-8
  4017	            // tail is withheld until a later token makes the delta complete.
  4018	            if pendingBytes.isEmpty, heldText.last != "\u{fffd}" {
  4019	                if cleanUpTokenizationSpaces {
  4020	                    appendCleaned(heldText)
  4021	                } else {
  4022	                    text += heldText
  4023	                }
  4024	                heldText.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)
  4025	            }
  4026	            return text
  4027	        }
  4028	
  4029	        private func appendCleaned(_ delta: String) {
  4030	            let suffixStart = text.index(text.endIndex, offsetBy: -4, limitedBy: text.startIndex)
  4031	                ?? text.startIndex
  4032	            let suffix = (String(text[suffixStart...]) + delta)
  4033	                .replacingOccurrences(of: " .", with: ".")
  4034	                .replacingOccurrences(of: " ?", with: "?")
  4035	                .replacingOccurrences(of: " !", with: "!")
  4036	                .replacingOccurrences(of: " ,", with: ",")
  4037	                .replacingOccurrences(of: " ' ", with: "'")
  4038	                .replacingOccurrences(of: " n't", with: "n't")
  4039	                .replacingOccurrences(of: " 'm", with: "'m")
  4040	                .replacingOccurrences(of: " 's", with: "'s")
  4041	                .replacingOccurrences(of: " 've", with: "'ve")
  4042	                .replacingOccurrences(of: " 're", with: "'re")
  4043	            text.replaceSubrange(suffixStart..., with: suffix)
  4044	        }
  4045	
  4046	        private static func byteLevelBytes(_ piece: String) -> [UInt8]? {
  4047	            var bytes: [UInt8] = []
  4048	            bytes.reserveCapacity(piece.unicodeScalars.count)
  4049	            for scalar in piece.unicodeScalars {
  4050	                guard let byte = byteDecoder[scalar] else { return nil }
  4051	                bytes.append(byte)
  4052	            }
  4053	            return bytes
  4054	        }
  4055	
  4056	        private static func incompleteUTF8SuffixCount(_ bytes: [UInt8]) -> Int {
  4057	            guard let last = bytes.last, last >= 0x80 else { return 0 }
  4058	            var continuationCount = 0
  4059	            var index = bytes.count - 1
  4060	            while bytes[index] & 0xC0 == 0x80 {
  4061	                continuationCount += 1
  4062	                guard index > 0 else { return 0 }
  4063	                index -= 1
  4064	            }
  4065	            let expected: Int
  4066	            switch bytes[index] {
  4067	            case 0xC2...0xDF: expected = 2
  4068	            case 0xE0...0xEF: expected = 3
  4069	            case 0xF0...0xF4: expected = 4
  4070	            default: return 0
  4071	            }
  4072	            let available = continuationCount + 1
  4073	            return available < expected ? available : 0
  4074	        }
  4075	
  4076	        private static let byteDecoder: [Unicode.Scalar: UInt8] = {
  4077	            var bytes = Array(33...126) + Array(161...172) + Array(174...255)
  4078	            var scalars = bytes
  4079	            var nextScalar = 256
  4080	            for byte in 0...255 where !bytes.contains(byte) {
  4081	                bytes.append(byte)
  4082	                scalars.append(nextScalar)
  4083	                nextScalar += 1
  4084	            }
  4085	            return Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: zip(scalars, bytes).compactMap { scalar, byte in
  4086	                Unicode.Scalar(scalar).map { ($0, UInt8(byte)) }
  4087	            })
  4088	        }()
  4089	    }

  4091	    /// A batched streaming row's buyer-visible state (SPEC-038 AC-6c). Serial
  4092	    /// tool turns retain per-token emitter precision through the byte-level
  4093	    /// incremental decoder; every other row decodes once per delivery event.
  4094	    /// Once the serial path would have stopped generating, later tokens are
  4095	    /// ignored and the stop point is kept so finalize truncates the row to it.
  4096	    final class AttachedPagedKVStreamState: @unchecked Sendable {
  4097	        private let lock = NSLock()
  4098	        private var tokenIDs: [Int] = []
  4099	        private var emitter: SerialStreamingTextEmitter
  4100	        private var recordedError: APIError?
  4101	        private var stoppedValue = false
  4102	        private var serialStopTokenCountValue: Int?
  4103	        private let decode: ([Int]) -> String
  4104	        private let incrementalDecoder: IncrementalTextDecoder?
  4105	        private let needsPerTokenPrecision: Bool
  4200	                structuredAccumulator: structuredAccumulator,
  4201	                idleState: idleState,
  4202	                onChunk: onChunk
  4203	            )
  4204	        }
  4205	
  4206	        /// Token count at which the serial path would have stopped a serial
  4207	        /// tool turn; nil when it would not have stopped early.
  4208	        var serialStopTokenCount: Int? {
  4209	            lock.lock()
  4210	            defer { lock.unlock() }
  4211	            return serialStopTokenCountValue
  4212	        }
  4213	
  4214	        var hasObservedTokens: Bool {
  4215	            lock.lock()
  4216	            defer { lock.unlock() }
  4217	            return !tokenIDs.isEmpty
  4218	        }
  4219	
  4220	        func error() -> APIError? {
  4221	            lock.lock()
  4222	            defer { lock.unlock() }
  4223	            return recordedError
  4224	        }
  4225	    }

  4227	    /// A batched non-streaming serial tool turn (SPEC-038 AC-6c): the serial
  4228	    /// non-streaming stop test over each delivered token.
  4229	    final class ContinuousBatchSerialToolStopState: @unchecked Sendable {
  4230	        private let lock = NSLock()
  4231	        private var tokenIDs: [Int] = []
  4232	        private var observer: NativeToolCallStreamEmitter
  4233	        private var stopTokenCountValue: Int?
  4234	        private let incrementalDecoder: IncrementalTextDecoder
  4235	
  4236	        init(request: ChatCompletionRequest, incrementalDecoder: IncrementalTextDecoder) {
  4237	            observer = NativeToolCallStreamEmitter(
  4238	                modelID: request.model,
  4239	                allowedFunctionNames: ModelRuntime.toolFunctionNames(from: request.promptSource.tools)
  4240	            )
  4241	            self.incrementalDecoder = incrementalDecoder
  4242	        }
  4243	
  4244	        /// Returns true the first time the row should stop decoding.
  4245	        func observe(
  4246	            eventTokens: [Int],
  4247	            stopTokenFilter: StopTokenFilter,
  4248	            requestStops: [String]
  4249	        ) -> Bool {
  4250	            lock.lock()
  4251	            defer { lock.unlock() }
  4252	            guard stopTokenCountValue == nil, !eventTokens.isEmpty else { return false }
  4253	            for token in eventTokens {
  4254	                tokenIDs.append(token)
  4255	                if ModelRuntime.observeSerialToolStop(
  4256	                    &observer,
  4257	                    decoded: incrementalDecoder.append(token),
  4258	                    stopTokenFilter: stopTokenFilter,
  4259	                    requestStops: requestStops
  4260	                ) {
  4261	                    stopTokenCountValue = tokenIDs.count
  4262	                    return true
  4263	                }
  4264	            }
  4265	            return false
  4266	        }
  4267	
  4268	        var stopTokenCount: Int? {
  4269	            lock.lock()
  4270	            defer { lock.unlock() }
  4271	            return stopTokenCountValue
  4272	        }
  4273	    }
  4274	
  4275	    struct ContinuousBatchFinalizedRow: Sendable {
  4276	        /// Not yet structured-validated: the non-streaming caller runs
  4277	        /// `validateStructuredCompletion`, the streaming caller first sends
  4278	        /// the held-back text and then `validateStructuredStreamingCompletion`,
  4279	        /// each exactly as its serial counterpart does.
  4280	        let completion: CompletionResult
  4281	        let filteredText: String
  4282	        let parsed: ParsedGeneratedOutput
  4283	        /// Generated tokens the completion accounts for (model EOS dropped,
  4284	        /// truncated to the serial stop point).
  4285	        let generatedTokens: [Int]
  4286	        /// The row decoded past the serial stop point, so its retained cache
  4287	        /// covers tokens the completion does not and must not be committed.
  4288	        let truncatedAtSerialStop: Bool
  4289	    }
  4290	
  4291	    /// Builds the one serial-tool observer owned by the canonical scheduler
  4292	    /// row. Its boundary is copied into the scheduler result for every waiter.
  4293	    static func continuousBatchSerialToolStopObserver(
  4294	        request: ChatCompletionRequest,
  4295	        detokenizer: StreamingDetokenizer,
  4296	        stopTokenFilter: StopTokenFilter
  4297	    ) -> ContinuousBatchCanonicalStopObserver? {
  4298	        guard serialNativeToolStopApplies(request) else { return nil }
  4299	        let state = ContinuousBatchSerialToolStopState(
  4300	            request: request,
  4301	            incrementalDecoder: detokenizer.makeIncremental()
  4302	        )
  4303	        return ContinuousBatchCanonicalStopObserver { token in
  4304	            state.observe(
  4305	                eventTokens: [token],
  4306	                stopTokenFilter: stopTokenFilter,
  4307	                requestStops: request.stop
  4308	            )
  4309	        }
  4310	    }
  4311	
  4312	    /// SPEC-038 AC-6c: the one post-generation finalize for a batched row,
  4313	    /// streaming and non-streaming. It applies the serial path's response
  4314	    /// byte cap, output filters, `parseGeneratedOutput` (tool calls,
  4315	    /// SPEC-018 caps, Harmony) and finish-reason rule to the row's text. A
  4316	    /// serial tool turn is first truncated to the token at which the serial
  4317	    /// path stops generating, so the parsed text and billed tokens match.
  4318	    static func finalizeContinuousBatchRow(
  4319	        request: ChatCompletionRequest,
  4320	        result: ContinuousBatchSchedulerResult,
  4321	        modelStopTokenIDs: Set<Int>,
  4322	        promptTokenIDs: [Int32],
  4323	        decode: ([Int]) -> String,
  4324	        stopTokenFilter: StopTokenFilter,
  4325	        generationMilliseconds: Int64,
  4326	        modelHash: String?
  4327	    ) throws -> ContinuousBatchFinalizedRow {
  4328	        // The serial path discards the model's end-of-generation token
  4329	        // before counting it; bill and cache the batched row the same way.
  4330	        // Harmony `<|return|>`/`<|call|>` are excluded from this set, as
  4331	        // they are from the serial stop set: the parser reads and counts them.
  4332	        let rawGeneratedTokenCount = result.generatedTokens.count
  4333	        let serialStopTokenCount = result.serialToolStopTokenCount
  4334	        var generatedTokens = droppingTrailingModelStop(
  4335	            result.generatedTokens,
  4336	            terminalStatus: result.terminalStatus,
  4337	            modelStopTokenIDs: modelStopTokenIDs
  4338	        )
  4339	        var completionTokenCount = result.completionTokens
  4340	            - (result.generatedTokens.count - generatedTokens.count)
  4341	        var outputTokens = result.outputTokens
  4342	        var truncated = false
  4343	        if let serialStopTokenCount, serialStopTokenCount < generatedTokens.count {
  4344	            completionTokenCount -= generatedTokens.count - serialStopTokenCount
  4345	            generatedTokens = Array(generatedTokens.prefix(serialStopTokenCount))
  4346	            outputTokens = Array(outputTokens.prefix(serialStopTokenCount))
  4347	            truncated = true
  4348	        }
  4349	        let decoded = decode(outputTokens)
  4350	        guard decoded.utf8.count <= ToolCallParser.SPEC018_ARGUMENTS_PER_RESPONSE_BYTE_CAP else {
  4351	            throw APIError(
  4352	                status: 502,
  4353	                message: "Model response exceeded 2097152 bytes",
  4354	                type: "upstream_provider_error",
  4355	                code: "response_byte_cap_exceeded",
  4356	                inferenceRan: true,
  4357	                settlementRan: true
  4358	            )
  4359	        }
  4360	        let filtered = applyOutputFilters(
  4361	            decoded,
  4362	            stopTokenFilter: stopTokenFilter,
  4363	            requestStops: request.stop
  4364	        )
  4365	        // Serial reports `length` only for an explicitly supplied max_tokens
  4366	        // reached by the pre-truncation generation. The scheduler's implicit
  4367	        // context budget is an implementation limit, not an OpenAI length end.
  4368	        let lengthTerminal = request.maxTokens.map { rawGeneratedTokenCount >= $0 } == true
  4369	            && !truncated
  4370	        let parserFinishReason = lengthTerminal && !filtered.hitStop
  4371	            ? "length"
  4372	            : (filtered.hitStop ? "request_stop" : "stop")
  4373	        let parsed = try parseGeneratedOutput(
  4374	            filteredText: filtered.text,
  4375	            generatedTokenIDs: generatedTokens,
  4376	            decode: decode,
  4377	            request: request,
  4378	            mode: .complete(finishReason: parserFinishReason),
  4379	            defaultCompletionTokens: completionTokenCount,
  4380	            stopTokenFilter: stopTokenFilter,
  4381	            requestStops: request.stop,
  4382	            globalHitStop: filtered.hitStop
  4383	        )
  4384	        let finishReason: String
  4385	        if !parsed.toolCalls.isEmpty {
  4386	            finishReason = "tool_calls"
  4387	        } else if lengthTerminal, !filtered.hitStop, !parsed.hitStop {
  4388	            finishReason = "length"
  4389	        } else {
  4390	            finishReason = "stop"
  4391	        }
  4392	        let kvCacheBytesReused = cachedPromptUTF8Bytes(
  4393	            promptTokenIds: promptTokenIDs,
  4394	            cachedPromptTokens: result.cachedPromptTokens,
  4395	            decode: decode
  4396	        )
  4397	        return ContinuousBatchFinalizedRow(
  4398	            completion: CompletionResult(
  4399	                content: parsed.content,
  4400	                finishReason: finishReason,
  4401	                promptTokens: promptTokenIDs.count,
  4402	                cachedPromptTokens: result.cachedPromptTokens,
  4403	                kvCacheBytesReused: kvCacheBytesReused,
  4404	                completionTokens: parsed.completionTokens,
  4405	                generatedCompletionTokens: parsed.generatedCompletionTokens,
  4406	                ttftMilliseconds: nil,
  4407	                generationMilliseconds: generationMilliseconds,
  4408	                toolCalls: parsed.toolCalls.isEmpty ? nil : parsed.toolCalls,
  4409	                modelHashObserved: validObservedModelHash(modelHash),
  4410	                settlementDisposition: result.settlementDisposition
  4411	            ),
  4412	            filteredText: filtered.text,
  4413	            parsed: parsed,
  4414	            generatedTokens: generatedTokens,
  4415	            truncatedAtSerialStop: truncated
  4416	        )
  4417	    }

  4419	    /// SPEC-038 AC-6c: the batched streaming end, in the serial stream's
  4420	    /// order: remaining tool-call deltas and held-back content first, then
  4421	    /// the structured verdict on the buyer-visible text.
  4422	    static func finishContinuousBatchStream(
  4423	        _ finalized: ContinuousBatchFinalizedRow,
  4424	        state: AttachedPagedKVStreamState,
  4425	        request: ChatCompletionRequest,
  4426	        structuredAccumulator: StructuredStreamingContentAccumulator,
  4427	        idleState: StructuredStreamingIdleState,
  4428	        onChunk: (StreamChunk) -> Void
  4429	    ) throws -> CompletionResult {
  4430	        try state.finish(
  4431	            finalText: finalized.filteredText,
  4432	            parsed: finalized.parsed,
  4433	            structuredAccumulator: structuredAccumulator,
  4434	            idleState: idleState,
  4435	            onChunk: onChunk
  4436	        )
  4437	        return try validateStructuredStreamingCompletion(
  4438	            finalized.completion,
  4439	            request: request,
  4440	            buyerVisibleContent: structuredAccumulator.content
  4441	        )
  4442	    }

  4444	    private func serialRouteCanaryCachedHitMissingRetainedHandoff(
  4445	        _ lease: ConversationCacheLease?,
  4540	    /// one at or below the cached length (they are a prefix of this prompt).
  4541	    /// Empty unless the lease resumes a retained hybrid entry.
  4542	    nonisolated static func retainedRecurrentCheckpoints(
  4543	        for lease: ConversationCacheLease?
  4544	    ) -> [RecurrentStateCheckpoint] {
  4545	        guard let lease,
  4546	              lease.recurrentCheckpoint != nil,
  4547	              let reusable = lease.reusableCache,
  4548	              reusable.retainedPagedKVSequence != nil
  4549	        else { return [] }
  4550	        return reusable.recurrentCheckpoints.filter { $0.tokenCount <= lease.cachedPromptTokens }
  4551	    }

  4553	    private func attachedContinuousBatchCompletion(
  4554	        request: ChatCompletionRequest,
  4555	        snapshot: RuntimeSnapshot,
  4556	        capability: ContinuousBatchingCapability,
  4557	        completionStartedAt: Date,
  4558	        shouldCancel: @escaping @Sendable () -> Bool,
  4559	        drainCancelled: DrainCancelToken
  4560	    ) async throws -> CompletionResult? {
  4561	        guard capability.isRequested,
  4562	              capability.unsupportedReason == nil,
  4563	              !capability.shouldUseSerialPath,
  4564	              case .attached = pagedKVAttachDecision
  4565	        else {
  4566	            return nil
  4567	        }
  4568	        guard let scheduler = continuousBatchScheduler else {
  4569	            throw Self.attachedPagedKVUnavailableError(code: "continuous_batching_scheduler_unavailable")
  4570	        }
  4571	        guard let schedulerRequestID = Self.schedulerRequestID(for: request) else {
  4572	            throw Self.attachedPagedKVUnavailableError(code: ContinuousBatchingUnsupportedReason.stableRequestIDUnavailable.apiCode)
  4573	        }
  4574	        guard let container = snapshot.container else {
  4575	            throw APIError(status: 503, message: "Model not loaded", type: "server_error", code: "model_not_loaded")
  4576	        }
  4577	
  4578	        let maxContextTokens = maxContextTokens
  4579	        let stopTokenFilter = stopTokenFilter
  4580	        let templateSupportsThinkingToggle = snapshot.templateSupportsThinkingToggle
  4581	        CBTrace.log(schedulerRequestID, "rt_cb_prepare")
  4582	        let (prepared, detokenizer) = try await container.perform { context -> (ContinuousBatchPreparedRequest, StreamingDetokenizer) in
  4583	            try drainCancelled.check()
  4584	            try Task.checkCancellation()
  4585	            let input = try Self.userInput(
  4586	                for: request,
  4587	                templateSupportsThinkingToggle: templateSupportsThinkingToggle
  4588	            )
  4589	            let lmInput = try await context.processor.prepare(input: input)
  4590	            let promptTokens = lmInput.text.tokens.asArray(Int32.self).map(Int.init)
  4591	            try Self.validatePromptTokenCount(promptTokens.count, maxContextTokens: maxContextTokens)
  4592	            let stopTokenSequences = Self.continuousBatchStopTokenSequences(
  4593	                requestStops: request.stop,
  4594	                context: context
  4595	            )
  4596	            let tokenizer = context.tokenizer
  4597	            // Only keyed requests can hold or reuse conversation state.
  4598	            let hybrid = Self.nonEmpty(request.conversationKey) != nil
  4599	                && ConversationCacheLayers.hasRecurrentLayers(context.model.newCache(parameters: nil))
  4600	            return (
  4601	                ContinuousBatchPreparedRequest(
  4602	                    promptTokens: promptTokens,
  4603	                    stopTokenSequences: stopTokenSequences,
  4604	                    modelStopTokenIDs: Self.generationStopTokenIDs(
  4605	                        for: Self.harmonyTerminalPreservingContext(from: context, modelID: request.model)
  4606	                    ),
  4607	                    recurrentCheckpointPositions: Self.continuousBatchRecurrentCheckpointPositions(
  4608	                        promptTokens: promptTokens,
  4609	                        conversationKey: request.conversationKey,
  4610	                        hybrid: hybrid,
  4611	                        context: context
  4612	                    ),
  4613	                    modelHasRecurrentLayers: hybrid
  4614	                ),
  4615	                StreamingDetokenizer(tokenizer: tokenizer)
  4616	            )
  4617	        }
  4618	
  4619	        try drainCancelled.check()
  4620	        try Task.checkCancellation()
  4621	        if shouldCancel() { throw CancellationError() }
  4622	        let maxOutputTokens = request.maxTokens ?? max(1, maxContextTokens - prepared.promptTokens.count)
  4623	        let preparedPromptTokenIDs = prepared.promptTokens.map(Int32.init)
  4624	        let batchKVBits = Self.effectiveKVBits(
  4625	            configured: kvBitsOverride,
  4626	            conversationKey: request.conversationKey
  4627	        )
  4628	        let lease = await conversationCache.begin(
  4629	            conversationKey: request.conversationKey,
  4630	            incomingTokens: preparedPromptTokenIDs,
  4631	            modelID: request.model,
  4632	            kvBits: batchKVBits,
  4633	            allowRetainedPagedKVHandoff: true
  4634	        )
  4635	        CBTrace.log(schedulerRequestID, "rt_cb_lease cached=\(lease?.cachedPromptTokens ?? -1)")
  4636	        if try await serialRouteCanaryCachedHitMissingRetainedHandoff(
  4637	            lease,
  4638	            capability: capability,
  4639	            modelHasRecurrentLayers: prepared.modelHasRecurrentLayers
  4640	        ) {
  4641	            return nil
  4642	        }
  4643	        // SPEC-038 AC-6c: the scheduler row owns the one canonical serial
  4644	        // tool boundary; every duplicate and terminal replay receives it.
  4645	        let serialToolStop = Self.continuousBatchSerialToolStopObserver(
  4646	            request: request,
  4647	            detokenizer: detokenizer,
  4648	            stopTokenFilter: stopTokenFilter
  4649	        )
  4650	        let result: ContinuousBatchSchedulerResult
  4651	        do {
  4652	            CBTrace.log(schedulerRequestID, "rt_cb_submit")
  4653	            result = try await Self.withDrainAndClientCancellation(drainCancelled, shouldCancel: shouldCancel) {
  4654	                try await scheduler.submit(ContinuousBatchSchedulerRequest(
  4655	                    id: schedulerRequestID,
  4656	                    conversationKey: request.conversationKey ?? "",
  4657	                    promptTokens: prepared.promptTokens,
  4658	                    maxOutputTokens: maxOutputTokens,
  4659	                    stopTokenSequences: prepared.stopTokenSequences,
  4660	                    samplerSeed: ContinuousBatchRowSampler.requestSeed(requestID: schedulerRequestID),
  4661	                    temperature: request.temperature,
  4662	                    topP: request.topP,
  4663	                    presencePenalty: request.presencePenalty,
  4664	                    frequencyPenalty: request.frequencyPenalty,
  4665	                    cachedPromptTokens: lease?.cachedPromptTokens ?? 0,
  4666	                    retainedPagedKVSequence: lease?.reusableCache?.retainedPagedKVSequence,
  4667	                    recurrentCheckpointPositions: prepared.recurrentCheckpointPositions,
  4668	                    retainedRecurrentCheckpoints: Self.retainedRecurrentCheckpoints(for: lease),
  4669	                    serialToolStopObserver: serialToolStop
  4670	                ))
  4671	            }
  4672	        } catch {
  4673	            if let lease {
  4674	                await conversationCache.abort(lease)
  4675	            }
  4676	            // SPEC-038 AC-25: one shared scheduler-error map, so the
  4677	            // non-streaming and streaming paths cannot drift.
  4678	            CBTrace.log(schedulerRequestID, "rt_cb_threw \(type(of: error))")
  4679	            throw (error as? ContinuousBatchSchedulerError)?.asAPIError() ?? error
  4680	        }
  4681	        CBTrace.log(schedulerRequestID, "rt_cb_returned status=\(result.terminalStatus)")
  4682	        do {
  4683	            try drainCancelled.check()
  4684	            try Task.checkCancellation()
  4685	            if shouldCancel() { throw CancellationError() }
  4686	            guard result.terminalStatus == .stop || result.terminalStatus == .length else {

   269	/// Thread-safe runtime-only observer owned by the canonical scheduler row.
   270	/// Its handler consumes one newly visible token at a time and therefore never

   283	    func observe(_ tokens: [Int]) -> Bool {

   290	                stopTokenCountValue = observedTokenCount
   291	                return true
   292	            }
   293	        }
   294	        return false
   295	    }

   297	    var stopTokenCount: Int? {
   298	        lock.lock()
   299	        defer { lock.unlock() }

  3283	    private func validatedRetainedTokenCost(

  3288	            request.maxOutputTokens
  3289	        )

  3292	        for sequence in request.stopTokenSequences {
  3293	            let (next, overflow) = stopTokens.addingReportingOverflow(sequence.count)
  3294	            guard !overflow, next <= configuration.maxTotalStopTokens else { return nil }
  3295	            stopTokens = next
  3296	        }
  3297	        let (retained, retainedOverflow) = request.promptTokens.count.addingReportingOverflow(stopTokens)

  3299	        return retained
  3300	    }

  3313	            pendingBindingTokenCount

  3337	    private func waitForAdmissionTurn(_ sequence: UInt64) async {
  3338	        precondition(sequence >= currentAdmissionSequence, "admission sequence cannot move backward")
  3339	        guard sequence != currentAdmissionSequence else { return }
  3340	        await withCheckedContinuation { continuation in
  3341	            precondition(admissionTurnWaiters[sequence] == nil, "admission sequence waiter must be unique")
  3342	            admissionTurnWaiters[sequence] = continuation
  3343	        }
  3344	    }

  3346	    private func finishAdmissionTurn(_ sequence: UInt64) {
  3347	        precondition(sequence == currentAdmissionSequence, "admission must advance in FCFS order")

  3349	        admissionTurnWaiters.removeValue(forKey: currentAdmissionSequence)?.resume()
  3350	    }

class DecoderSequence: Decoder {
    let decoders: [Decoder]

    required init(config: Config) {
        guard let configs = config.decoders.array() else { fatalError("No decoders in Sequence") }
        decoders = configs.compactMap { DecoderFactory.fromConfig(config: $0) }
    }

    func decode(tokens: [String]) -> [String] {
        decoders.reduce(tokens) { current, decoder in
            decoder(tokens: current)
        }
    }
}

class ByteLevelDecoder: Decoder {
    let addedTokens: Set<String>

    required init(config: Config) {
        addedTokens = []
    }

    init(config: Config, addedTokens: Set<String>?) {
        self.addedTokens = addedTokens ?? []
    }

    func decode(tokens: [String]) -> [String] {
        var subTexts: [String] = []
        var currentSubText: [String] = []

        func convertTokensToString(_ tokens: [String]) -> String {
            let text = tokens.joined(separator: "")

            let utfCodepoints = text.map { byteDecoder[String($0)]! }
            return String(decoding: utfCodepoints, as: UTF8.self)
        }

        for token in tokens {
            if addedTokens.contains(token) {
                if !currentSubText.isEmpty {
                    subTexts.append(convertTokensToString(currentSubText))
                    currentSubText = []
                }
                subTexts.append(token)
            } else {
                currentSubText.append(token)
            }
        }

        if !currentSubText.isEmpty {
            subTexts.append(convertTokensToString(currentSubText))
        }

        return subTexts
    }
}

class ReplaceDecoder: Decoder {
    let pattern: StringReplacePattern?

    required init(config: Config) {
        pattern = StringReplacePattern.from(config: config)
    }

    func decode(tokens: [String]) -> [String] {
        guard let pattern else { return tokens }
        return tokens.map { pattern.replace($0) }
    }
}

class ByteFallbackDecoder: Decoder {
    required init(config: Config) {}

    func decode(tokens: [String]) -> [String] {
        var newTokens: [String] = []
        var byteTokens: [Int] = []

        func parseByte(_ token: String) -> Int? {
            guard token.count == 6, token.hasPrefix("<0x"), token.hasSuffix(">") else {
                return nil
            }
            let startIndex = token.index(token.startIndex, offsetBy: 3)
            let endIndex = token.index(token.startIndex, offsetBy: 5)
            return Int(token[startIndex..<endIndex], radix: 16)
        }

        for token in tokens {
            if let byte = parseByte(token) {
                byteTokens.append(byte)
            } else {
                if !byteTokens.isEmpty {
                    // decode as utf8 and append
                    let codeUnits = byteTokens.map { UTF8.CodeUnit($0) }
                    newTokens.append(String(decoding: codeUnits, as: UTF8.self))
                    byteTokens.removeAll()
                }
                newTokens.append(token)
            }
        }
        return newTokens
    }
}

class FuseDecoder: Decoder {
    required init(config: Config) {}

    func decode(tokens: [String]) -> [String] {
        [tokens.joined(separator: "")]
    }
}

class StripDecoder: Decoder {
    let content: String
    let start: Int
    let stop: Int

    required init(config: Config) {
        guard let content = config.content.string() else { fatalError("Incorrect StripDecoder configuration: can't parse `content`.") }
        guard let start = config.start.integer() else { fatalError("Incorrect StripDecoder configuration: can't parse `start`.") }
        guard let stop = config.stop.integer() else { fatalError("Incorrect StripDecoder configuration: can't parse `stop`.") }
        self.content = content
        self.start = start
        self.stop = stop
    }

    func decode(tokens: [String]) -> [String] {
        tokens.map { token in
            token.trimmingFromStart(upto: start).trimmingFromEnd(upto: stop)
            // text on the right) and (i, k) (now spanning the merged text on
            // the left). Stale entries left over for the old pairs in the
            // heap will be discarded when popped.
            if prevIndex[i] != -1 {
                enqueue(left: prevIndex[i])
            }
            enqueue(left: i)
        }

        // Walk the surviving symbols from the head (index 0 is never absorbed:
        // merges always move text from `next` into `current`, so position 0
        // remains alive throughout).
        var pieces: [String] = []
        pieces.reserveCapacity(initialCount)
        var cursor = 0
        while cursor != -1 {
            pieces.append(symbols[cursor])
            cursor = nextIndex[cursor]
        }
        return pieces
    }

    /// Tokenizes input text using the BPE algorithm.
    ///
    /// - Parameter text: The input text to tokenize
    /// - Returns: An array of BPE token strings
    func tokenize(text: String) -> [String] {
        var tokens: [String] = []
        let bpeTokens = bpe(token: text)
        for token in bpeTokens {
            if convertTokenToId(token) != unknownTokenId {
                tokens.append(token)
            } else {
                // TODO: if config.byte_fallback is False, append the unknown token instead
                tokens.append(contentsOf: hexaEncode(text: token))
            }
        }
        return tokens
    }
}

import Foundation

/// A protocol for decoding operations that convert tokens back to readable text.
///
/// Decoders handle the reverse transformation of tokens into human-readable text,
/// performing operations like removing special prefixes, converting byte representations
/// back to characters, and joining token pieces into words.
public protocol Decoder {
    /// Decodes tokens back into text components.
    ///
    /// - Parameter tokens: The token strings to decode
    /// - Returns: An array of decoded text components
    func decode(tokens: [String]) -> [String]

    /// Function call syntax for token decoding.
    ///
    /// - Parameter tokens: The token strings to decode
    /// - Returns: An array of decoded text components
    func callAsFunction(tokens: [String]) -> [String]

    /// Initializes the decoder from configuration.
    ///
    /// - Parameter config: The configuration for this decoder
    init(config: Config)
}

extension Decoder {
    func callAsFunction(tokens: [String]) -> [String] {
        decode(tokens: tokens)
    }
}

enum DecoderType: String {
    case Sequence
    case WordPiece
    case ByteLevel
    case Replace
    case ByteFallback
    case Fuse
    case Strip
    case Metaspace
    case Unknown = ""
}

struct DecoderFactory {
    static func fromConfig(config: Config?, addedTokens: Set<String>? = nil) -> Decoder? {
        // TODO: not sure if we need to include `addedTokens` in all the decoder initializers (and the protocol)
        guard let config else { return nil }
        guard let typeName = config.type.string() else { return nil }
        let type = DecoderType(rawValue: typeName)
        switch type {
        case .Sequence: return DecoderSequence(config: config)
        case .ByteLevel: return ByteLevelDecoder(config: config, addedTokens: addedTokens)
        case .Replace: return ReplaceDecoder(config: config)
        case .ByteFallback: return ByteFallbackDecoder(config: config)
        case .Fuse: return FuseDecoder(config: config)
        case .Strip: return StripDecoder(config: config)
        case .Metaspace: return MetaspaceDecoder(config: config)
        case .WordPiece: return WordPieceDecoder(config: config)
        default: fatalError("Unsupported Decoder type: \(typeName)")
        }
    }
}

    required init(config: Config) {
        guard let prefix = config.prefix.string() else { fatalError("Missing `prefix` configuration for WordPieceDecoder.") }
        self.prefix = prefix
        cleanup = config.cleanup.boolean(or: false)
    }

    func decode(tokens: [String]) -> [String] {
        let firstToken = cleanup ? cleanUpTokenization(tokens.first!) : tokens.first!
        return [firstToken]
            + tokens.dropFirst().map { token in
                let token = token.hasPrefix(prefix) ? token.replacingCharacters(in: token.range(of: prefix)!, with: "") : " \(token)"
                return cleanup ? cleanUpTokenization(token) : token
            }
    }

    /// https://github.com/huggingface/tokenizers/blob/main/tokenizers/src/decoders/wordpiece.rs#L40
    private func cleanUpTokenization(_ token: String) -> String {
        let range = NSRange(location: 0, length: token.utf16.count)
        return re.stringByReplacingMatches(in: token, options: [], range: range, withTemplate: "$1")
            .replacingOccurrences(of: " do not", with: " don't")
    }
}

  7708	    /// Converts a JSONValue subtree into the `Any` graph the chat template
  7709	    /// consumes, preserving every key and array position. JSON null becomes a
  7710	    /// native `Jinja.Value.null` (not `NSNull` and not an omission): swift-jinja
  7711	    /// `Value(any:)` matches `case let value as Value` and passes it through,
  7712	    /// so `default:null`, `const:null`, `enum:[null,…]`, and positional array
  7713	    /// nulls survive round-trip with their original schema semantics (#718/#719).
  7714	    ///
  7715	    /// Recursion is bounded by the caller, not here: tool schemas are rejected
  7716	    /// at `validateTools` (ChatCompletionRequest) when they exceed
  7717	    /// `JSONSchemaValidator.maxDepth`, before `JSONValue.parse` builds the tree
  7718	    /// this walk consumes. So every value reaching here is already depth-capped,
  7719	    /// and the converter can stay a faithful shape-preserving pass with no
  7720	    /// silent truncation of over-deep subtrees.
  7721	    private static func jsonAnyForTemplate(_ value: MacProviderCore.JSONValue) -> Any {
  7722	        switch value {
  7723	        case .object(let object):
  7724	            var result: [String: Any] = [:]
  7725	            result.reserveCapacity(object.count)
  7726	            for (key, member) in object {
  7727	                result[key] = jsonAnyForTemplate(member)
  7728	            }
  7729	            return result
  7730	        case .array(let array):
  7731	            return array.map { jsonAnyForTemplate($0) }
  7732	        case .string(let string):
  7733	            return string
  7734	        case .int(let int):
  7735	            return int
  7736	        case .double(let double):
  7737	            return double
  7738	        case .bool(let bool):
  7739	            return bool
  7740	        case .null:
  7741	            return Jinja.Value.null
  7742	        }
  7743	    }

Commit:     Augustas11 <augstar@gmail.com>

    Preserve serial completion boundaries across batched replays
    
    Constraint: SPEC-038 v0.2.11 AC-6c requires batched rows to reuse serial finalization semantics.
    Rejected: Per-waiter replay observers | delivery chunking cannot define billing or cache settlement.
    Confidence: high
    Scope-risk: narrow
    Directive: Keep tool-stop billing boundaries derived from canonical row tokens.
    Tested: swift build; focused 210-test gate; revert proofs for finish reason and replay truncation.
    Not-tested: Full Swift suite remains red in this environment (3538 tests, 71 skipped, 198 failures); an observed reconnect timing failure passed in isolation.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

commit b8c9229ae905a8078f9b396aff3023fc365d45e2
Author:     Augustas11 <augstar@gmail.com>
AuthorDate: Fri Sep 25 22:22:42 2026 +0800
Commit:     Augustas11 <augstar@gmail.com>
CommitDate: Fri Sep 25 22:34:58 2026 +0800

    Bound batched detokenization work at replay boundaries
    
    Constraint: SPEC-038 AC-6c keeps serial tool-turn billing and cache boundaries canonical across duplicate and terminal replays.
    Rejected: Recomputing serial tool stops during finalize | prefix decoding makes long tool argument streams quadratic.
    Confidence: high
    Scope-risk: narrow
    Directive: Keep canonical row stop state scheduler-owned; waiters may replay chunks, not redefine stop boundaries.
    Tested: swift build --disable-sandbox; filtered Swift tests (214 executed, 5 skipped, 0 failures); quadratic revert proof (8384 vs 128 plain, 8385 vs 129 tool).
    Not-tested: Full Swift suite, per operator instruction to avoid sandbox-hostile network/keychain tests.
    Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>
